newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - September 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - September 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Chief of UK's Midland Power Co. arrives in Dhaka on Monday to discuss setting up a 150-megawatt gas-fired power plant in Bangladesh.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has said Dhaka will not make any lofty promises to the Aid Club, due to meet in Paris later this week to announce development assistance to Bangladesh for 1996-97 fiscal year.
Bangladesh's popular film star Salman Shah has committed suicide whose death, the country's film producers said, could cost the industry at least 500 million taka ($12 million).
An Indian election observer team has said Thursday's by-election to 15 vacated seats to parliament were peaceful and well-organised.
A new university in the private sector was formally launched in Dhaka on Friday which, its sponsors said, would provide both campus and distance education.
